name: ettore-90s-v4
style: stylized illustrated comic art, ink outlines, warm flat colors, vintage 1950s Parisian restaurant, warm golden light, vertical composition, no text, no faces visible, faces hidden or out of frame.

scenes.image_prompt: an old man in a worn brown overcoat seen from behind, standing at the door of an elegant restaurant at dusk, hat in hand.
scenes.text: Lo cacciarono da un ristorante che portava il suo nome.

scenes.image_prompt: a brass restaurant sign on a facade reading nothing, ornate frame, evening street lamps, close-up.
scenes.text: Si chiamava Ettore, aveva ottant'anni, e quel locale l'aveva fondato lui.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of old wrinkled hands buttoning a worn brown overcoat, frayed cuffs.
scenes.text: Ogni anno, nel giorno dell'anniversario, entrava in incognito, con il suo vecchio cappotto consumato.

scenes.image_prompt: an old man in a worn brown overcoat seen from behind, sitting alone at a small corner table with a white tablecloth, hat on the chair.
scenes.text: Si sedeva sempre allo stesso tavolo, in fondo alla sala.

scenes.image_prompt: a man in a sharp navy blue suit with a gold watch seen from behind, sitting at the next table with two businessmen, papers and wine glasses.
scenes.text: Quella sera, al tavolo accanto, sedeva Leonardo, un imprenditore sicuro di sé, con i suoi investitori.

scenes.image_prompt: over-the-shoulder view from behind a man in a sharp navy blue suit with a gold watch, looking towards the old man in the brown overcoat across the room.
scenes.text: Squadrò l'anziano dall'alto in basso.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a hand with a gold watch covering a mouth, whispering gesture, only lower part of face out of frame, wine glass.
scenes.text: E sussurrò: questo posto non è per lui.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a hand with a gold watch raised, snapping fingers in the air, restaurant background blurred.
scenes.text: Schioccò le dita per chiamare il cameriere.

scenes.image_prompt: a young waiter in a white jacket seen from behind, hurrying between tables with a carafe, elegant dining room.
scenes.text: Arrivò Matteo, il ragazzo più giovane della sala.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of old wrinkled hands resting calmly folded on a white tablecloth, a napkin beside.
scenes.text: Ettore, con calma, disse soltanto: io non ho fretta.

scenes.image_prompt: extreme close-up of a waiter's trembling hands holding a glass carafe, water spilling on a white tablecloth.
scenes.text: Poi Matteo, per l'emozione, versò qualche goccia d'acqua.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a few drops of water on a white tablecloth near a crystal glass, dramatic light.
scenes.text: Una macchia piccola, quasi invisibile.

scenes.image_prompt: a man in a sharp navy blue suit with a gold watch seen from behind, standing up abruptly, chair pushed back, arm pointing.
scenes.text: Leonardo scattò in piedi: incompetente!

scenes.image_prompt: low angle from behind a man in a sharp navy blue suit with a gold watch pointing at the old man in the brown overcoat at the corner table.
scenes.text: E quel vecchio mendicante lo faccia uscire.

scenes.image_prompt: wide view of an elegant dining room, all diners frozen, cutlery suspended, seen from the back of the room, silhouettes only.
scenes.text: La sala cadde nel silenzio.

scenes.image_prompt: a maitre d' in a black tailcoat seen from behind, walking slowly across the dining room towards the corner table.
scenes.text: Allora il direttore attraversò la sala.

scenes.image_prompt: a maitre d' in a black tailcoat seen from behind, bowing deeply in front of the old man in the brown overcoat at the corner table.
scenes.text: Si inchinò davanti a Ettore: bentornato, signore.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of a framed old black and white photograph on the restaurant wall showing the restaurant opening day, crowd from behind.
scenes.text: Nella sala capirono tutti chi era quell'uomo.

scenes.image_prompt: two businessmen seen from behind, standing up and putting on their coats, leaving the table, papers left behind.
scenes.text: Gli investitori si alzarono, raccolsero i loro fogli e uscirono.

scenes.image_prompt: close-up of business papers and a fountain pen abandoned on a restaurant table, empty chairs.
scenes.text: Chi tratta così un cameriere, non tratterà meglio noi.

scenes.image_prompt: a man in a sharp navy blue suit with a gold watch seen from behind, sitting alone at an empty table, shoulders slumped, empty chairs around.
scenes.text: Leonardo rimase solo.

scenes.image_prompt: a young waiter in a white jacket and an old man in a worn brown overcoat seen from the side, only from the shoulders down, the young waiter leaning to listen.
scenes.text: Matteo chiese a Ettore: perché l'ha fatto?

scenes.image_prompt: extreme close-up of two hands shaking, one old and wrinkled, one young, on a white tablecloth, soft evening light.
scenes.text: Perché il rispetto si vede quando credi che nessuno conti.

scenes.image_prompt: still life of an elegant table setting, silverware perfectly arranged, a single candle, soft light.
scenes.text: Il galateo non è saper usare le posate.

scenes.image_prompt: an old man in a worn brown overcoat seen from behind, walking out of the restaurant into the evening street, hat on, warm light from the door.
scenes.text: È come tratti chi non può risponderti.

scenes.image_prompt: a black top hat on a white tablecloth beside a folded napkin, elegant, centered.
scenes.text: Segui le regole del gentleman. Ogni sera, una nuova.
